Name: Eos Valley - New Recipes
Author: Ciriun
Description:
That's it! I've come up with some new recipes!

This mod will add several new recipes based on ones from Final Fantasy XV.

Recipes included:
[list]
[*]Dish and Chips
[*]Burly Bean Bowl
[*]Fluffy Oyakodon
[*]Kenny's Salmon
[*]Memory Lane Pastry
[*]Cup Noodles
[*]Perfect Cup Noodles
[*]Golden Chocobo Tart
[*]Kupoberry Cheesecake
[/list]
To Do:
[list]
[*]Add more recipes
[*]Fix inevitable errors
[*]Add an alternate version for Khadija's Shop
[/list]
(The current version is something I threw together in one afternoon and is likely to be a bit glitchy. I tried to balance things but I probably did not do a very good job. If you find any errors or are better at balancing, please comment or send me a PM.)

P.S. I am proud of my little sprites but if you can do better and want to, let me know!
